title: Iron Legion formation template
description: Parameters for an engine layout function that turns a soldier count into slots. Files live under content/formations/. JSON5 is parsed to JSON before validation.

$override.description: Override mode when an item with this id already exists. Default merge.

$delete.description: Remove the item with this id from the registry.

$from.description: Copy this existing template as the base for a new id, then merge the remaining fields.

deprecated.description: Marks the item deprecated; message names the replacement.

default_ranks.description: Ranks used until the player adjusts depth.

min_ranks.description: Minimum ranks the player may set.

max_ranks.description: Maximum ranks the player may set.

spacing_file.description: Distance between adjacent soldiers in a rank, as a multiple of the soldier diameter (2 x soldier_radius); sf = spacing_file x 2r (SIM-FORM-002).

spacing_rank.description: Distance between ranks, as a multiple of the soldier diameter; sr = spacing_rank x 2r (SIM-FORM-002).

role_zones.description: Rank bands reserved for a unit category in mixed regiments. Ranks are 1-based from the front, inclusive.

morph_ticks.description: Transition ticks when morphing into this template; integrity is reduced meanwhile.

integrity_bonus_attack.description: Attack bonus at formation integrity 1.0, scaled linearly with integrity.

integrity_bonus_defence.description: Defence bonus at formation integrity 1.0, scaled linearly with integrity.

speed_mult.description: Movement speed multiplier while in this template.

custom_slots.description: Slot offsets from the anchor in soldier diameters (2 x soldier_radius): x right, y forward (rear ranks at negative y). Soldiers beyond the slot count form a Line behind (SIM-FORM-009).

min_files.description: On casualties, ranks are kept while files stay at or above this (SIM-FORM-021).

loose_mult.description: Spacing multiplier applied by the loose layout (SIM-FORM-008).

default_files_column.description: Files of the column layout; ranks follow from the count (SIM-FORM-004).
